title: Reserved question type — accepted on import

questions.title: Reserved type placeholder
questions.prompt: Per NORMATIVE.md §6 (Reserved and unknown types), consumers MUST accept reserved question types declared in question-base.schema.json's enum even when no per-type schema ships. The consumer MUST preserve the question verbatim across read/write cycles, MUST NOT silently drop it, and MUST treat its earned points as zero; the consumer MAY refuse to render or grade but MUST NOT reject the document on import for that reason alone.
